text: Hager Group is an independent family company based in Blieskastel, Germany, family-owned and family-run since its 1955 foundation; Hager SE, the family holding, is the named corporate président of French subsidiary Hager Electro SAS (Obernai, SIREN 675980114).
short: Hager Group is an independent family company (Hager family, Germany).
